reference.summary: A brown cartoon monkey clings to the trunk of a leafy apple tree full of red apples, under a sunny sky on a grassy hill; it is clearly drawn and well composed.

defects.what: An extra tan round blob sticks up behind the top of the monkey's head and reads as a stray shape.
defects.where: top right of the monkey's head
defects.expected: The monkey's head outline is clean, and any raised hand is clearly attached to an arm that grips the trunk.

defects.what: The raised hand on the left floats slightly beside the trunk instead of clearly gripping it.
defects.expected: Both hands visibly grip the trunk.

defects.what: The legs are thick loops whose feet end in loose tan dots, so the leg shapes are hard to read.
defects.where: the monkey's legs at the bottom of the trunk
defects.expected: The legs clearly bend around the trunk, with feet pressed against the bark.

attempt.summary: A small brown monkey on the trunk of a round green apple tree, with a sun and a readable caption 'A monkey climbing an apple tree'; the monkey's limbs are broken and its hands and feet float apart from the body.

defects.what: The two dark brown hand blobs float above the monkey at the base of the leaves and connect to no arm.
defects.where: just under the canopy, above the monkey
defects.expected: Each hand sits at the end of an arm and grips the trunk or a branch.

defects.what: There is only one clear arm, and one leg is missing. The feet are loose dark ovals that are detached from the body.
defects.expected: The monkey has two arms and two legs, each attached to the body and ending in a hand or foot on the trunk.

defects.what: The left limb is a thin curving line that looks more like a tail than an arm, so the pose is hard to read as climbing.
defects.expected: A clear climbing pose, with limbs wrapped around the trunk and a separate tail.

defects.what: Small dark arcs sit on top of the floating hand blobs like stray marks.
defects.where: the two dark blobs under the canopy
defects.expected: No stray marks around the hands.

defects.what: The apples are small round dots with thin hooked stems, so they look like cherries.
